title: Grandes civilizaciones
goal: Read about the Maya, Mexica and Inca in real depth, and talk about what made each distinctive.
grammar: Se pasiva / impersonal, y voz pasiva

items: Explain who the Maya, Mexica and Inca were, and roughly where and when each flourished.
Name at least two specific achievements of each civilisation.
Describe one thing historians still debate about these societies.
Correct the common myth that these civilisations simply disappeared.
Use se pasiva/impersonal and voz pasiva to talk about historical events.
